WITH all_teams_per_league AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.name as league_name, m.home_team_api_id as team_api_id
  FROM Match m
  JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT l.name as league_name, m.away_team_api_id as team_api_id
  FROM Match m
  JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
),
team_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    l.name as league_name,
    CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN m.home_team_api_id
         WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN m.away_team_api_id
         ELSE NULL END as winning_team_api_id
  FROM Match m
  JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
  WHERE m.home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND m.away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
    AND m.home_team_goal != m.away_team_goal
),
win_counts AS (
  SELECT league_name, winning_team_api_id, COUNT(*) as wins
  FROM team_wins
  GROUP BY league_name, winning_team_api_id
),
team_wins_with_names AS (
  SELECT atp.league_name, atp.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, COALESCE(wc.wins, 0) as total_wins
  FROM all_teams_per_league atp
  LEFT JOIN win_counts wc ON atp.league_name = wc.league_name AND atp.team_api_id = wc.winning_team_api_id
  LEFT JOIN Team t ON atp.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
)
SELECT league_name, team_long_name, total_wins
FROM team_wins_with_names
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league_name ORDER BY total_wins ASC, team_long_name ASC) = 1
ORDER BY league_name
